title: Logos 30 opening: glorify me with the glory I had
english: Thirtieth discourse. On “Father, glorify me with the glory I had with you before the world was.”
Asking glory does not prove lack; the Lord of glory needs no addition as bare Word.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
